summary: Iter45 premium homepage redesign — tested backend (site/homepage, site/config stats, site/promotions) and frontend Landing/HomeHero/HomeSections/Promotions/SiteFooter at 1440px and 390px. Backend 4/4 pytest passed. Frontend all data-testids render with correct real-data bindings; city=Patna flow rewrites trending title/eyebrow/booked badges; hero-search, chips, coupon-copy, service card, faq accordion, footer dynamic trust all work.

issues: City/pincode input lacks data-testid (only placeholder='City or pincode'); Set button also lacks data-testid. Adding data-testid='nav-location-input' and 'nav-location-set' would improve testability of the location flow.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='nav-location-input' and 'nav-location-set' to city input & Set button in SiteNavbar location dropdown for stable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx openLocation() uses querySelector to click nav-location — works, but consider exposing a shared LocationContext to avoid DOM click coupling.

HomeHero visuals slice(0,3) with 2 banners renders 2 side-by-side (grid-cols-2) — matches spec. If ever 3 banners come in, the first spans row-span-2 which changes aspect intent; consider capping to 2 for the side-by-side layout.

All homepage data is real: service_count populated per category, booking_count/local_booking_count present, trending sorted desc by local_booking_count when city passed, hero_banner filtered by date, /site/config.stats includes all required keys (jobs_done, partners, verified_partners, merchants, customers, reviews, rating, cities).
No hardcoded business data observed in the homepage modules; only UI labels.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded data as instructed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_homepage_iter45.py covers /api/site/homepage (with/without ?city=), stats keys and /site/promotions shape. Frontend flows verified: hero-search → /services?q=, hero-chip-<id> → /services?category=, home-cat-<i> click, home-featured_services-<i> → /service/<id>, coupon-copy sets localStorage azo_coupon, faq accordion, city=Patna repaints trending with 'Popular services near Patna' + '1 booked' badges. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow and bottom nav visible.
